stem: Meena's younger brother Arjun caught chickenpox. It is caused by a virus, and within a few days two other children in his class in Jaipur also fell ill after playing with him. How should this disease be classified?

options.text: Non-communicable, because it is caused by a virus inside the body
Communicable, because it is caused by a pathogen and spreads from person to person
Chronic, because it can last for more than a week
Non-communicable, because it cannot spread through air or water

teacher.key_rationale: Chickenpox is caused by a virus (a pathogen) and spreads from person to person, so it is communicable. Option A is the trap for a student who drops the 'spreads' condition and relies only on the germ word; option C traps students who treat any illness lasting some days as chronic (chronic means persisting more than about 3 months); option D contradicts the stated spread.
